sentences.zh: 其星自五月丁卯始見，戊辰往西南行，日益漸速，至六月辛未，芒彗愈長，約二尺餘，丁丑掃上丞，己卯光芒愈甚，約長三尺餘，入圜衛，壬午掃華蓋、杠星，乙酉掃鉤陳大星及天皇大帝，丙戌貫四輔，經樞心，甲午出圜衛，丁酉出紫微垣，戊戌犯貫索，掃天紀，七月庚子掃河間，癸卯經鄭、晉，入天市垣，丙午掃列肆，己酉太陰光盛，微辨芒彗，出天市垣，掃梁星，至辛酉，光芒微小，瞻在房宿鍵閉之上、罰星中星正西，難測，日漸南行，至是凡見六十有三日，自昴至房，凡歷一十五宿而滅。

translations.literal: Its star from fifth month dingmao first seen; wuchen went southwest, daily increasingly swift; to sixth month xinwei, ray-broom increasingly long, approximately two chi odd; dingchou swept Supreme Chancellor, jimao brilliance increasingly severe, approximately three chi odd in length; entered Round Guard; renwu swept Canopy of State, Pillar stars; yiyou swept Hook Array great star and Celestial Thearch; bingxu pierced Four Assistants, passed Pivot heart; jiawu exited Round Guard; dingyou exited Purple Forbidden Enclosure rampart; wuxu violated Piercing Ring, swept Heavenly Records; seventh month gengzi swept River Quarter; guimao passed Zheng, Jin, entered Celestial Market Enclosure rampart; bingwu swept Array of Shops; jiyou Great Yin light abundant, faintly discerned ray-broom; exited Celestial Market Enclosure rampart, swept Liang star; to xinyou, brilliance minute; viewed at Room mansion Key and Lock above, Punishment star central star due west, difficult to measure; daily gradually southward; to this altogether seen sixty-three days; from Mao to Room, altogether passed fifteen lodgings then extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: The comet was first seen on the day dingmao in the fifth month; on wuchen it moved toward the southwest, growing swifter day by day. By the day xinwei in the sixth month its rays had lengthened to about two feet. On dingchou it swept past the Supreme Chancellor; on jimao its brilliance intensified further, to about three feet in length. It entered the Round Guard. On renwu it swept through the Canopy of State and the Pillar stars; on yiyou it swept past the great star of the Hook Array and the Celestial Thearch; on bingxu it pierced the Four Assistants and passed through the Pivot heart. On jiawu it exited the Round Guard; on dingyou it exited the Purple Forbidden Enclosure. On wuxu it encroached upon the Piercing Ring and swept through the Heavenly Records. In the seventh month, on gengzi it swept through the River Quarter; on guimao it passed Zheng and Jin and entered the Celestial Market Enclosure. On bingwu it swept through the Array of Shops. On jiyou the moon's light was so bright that the comet's rays could barely be discerned; it exited the Celestial Market Enclosure and swept past the Liang star. By xinyou its brilliance had dwindled; it was observed above the Key and Lock of the Room mansion, due west of the central star of the Punishment star, but was difficult to measure as it moved gradually southward. By this time it had been visible for sixty-three days in all, passing through fifteen lodgings from the Mao to the Room before it vanished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太陰犯壘壁陣東方第六星。

translations.literal: Yiyou—Great Yin violated Encampment Wall Formation eastern sixth star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, the moon encroached upon the sixth star of the eastern Encampment Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，填星犯鍵閉，太陰犯畢大星。

translations.literal: Xinmao—Fill Star violated Key and Lock; Great Yin violated Net great star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, Saturn encroached upon the Key and Lock, and the moon encroached upon the great star of the Net.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太陰犯井宿西扇北第二星。

translations.literal: Guisi—Great Yin violated Well mansion western fan northern second star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, the moon encroached upon the second star north of the western fan of the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，熒惑犯斗宿西第二星。

translations.literal: Dingyou—Sparkling Deluder violated Dipper mansion western second star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, Mars encroached upon the second star west of the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，太陰犯畢宿右股西第二星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, wuwu—Great Yin violated Net mansion right thigh western second star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-seventh year of Zhizheng, on the day wuwu, the moon encroached upon the second star west of the right thigh of the Net mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太陰犯井宿東扇南第三星。

translations.literal: Xinyou—Great Yin violated Well mansion eastern fan southern third star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, the moon encroached upon the third star south of the eastern fan of the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太陰犯鬼宿西南星。

translations.literal: Guihai—Great Yin violated Ghost mansion southwestern star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, the moon encroached upon the southwestern star of the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，歲星、太白、熒惑聚於斗宿。

translations.literal: Dingmao—Year Star, White Metal, and Sparkling Deluder gathered at Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, Jupiter, Venus, and Mars gathered in the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuyin—White Metal day-seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twenty-seventh year of Zhizheng, on the day wuyin, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太陰犯壘壁陣東方南東第一星。

translations.literal: Gengchen—Great Yin violated Encampment Wall Formation eastern south-east first star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, the moon encroached upon the first star southeast of the eastern Encampment Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 余見本紀。

translations.literal: Remainder see Basic Annals.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder may be found in the Basic Annals.
